text: Hi there! What can I do for you? Hi, Professor. I wanted to ask if you knew of any opportunities to work as a lab assistant in the Language and Memory Lab. We’re actually looking for a lab assistant right now. Are you interested? Yes, I am! I’m very interested in linguistics research and I would love to work in your lab. Great! We’ll need someone who can help with data collection and analysis. Are you familiar with Microsoft Excel? Yes, I am. That’s great. We’ll also need someone who is able to commit for at least 10 hours a week. Are you available for that? Yes, I am available for that. Excellent! We’ll have an opening starting next week if you’re still interested. Yes, I’m still interested! Thank you so much for this opportunity!
